title: FBI calls Brigham Young its top recruiting source

tellings.quote: Like FBI's talked about how like Brigham Young is like their top source.

plain: The FBI is said to have called Brigham Young University, the Mormon university in Utah, its top source of recruits. Matthew Pines, a national security analyst, mentions this in passing to Michels without naming a source. If true, it would point to unusually close ties between one religious community and the federal security world.
